title: Two new dungeons
changes: The Lantern Crypt (Lv 13-17): a stair in the mausoleum on Barrow Downs leads down to two floors of catacombs. Brother Aldric's quests take you down to the Hollow Abbot.

The Undercity of Kharsun (Lv 40-44): climb down the old well in the Buried City to the Sunken Bazaar and the Vault of the Water-Kings. Zahir the tomb-robber's quests end at the Last Water-King's throne.
Both have ambush rooms, guarded hoards, a secret room on every floor and a shortcut back.
The new bosses talk while they fight.
